description: Shipped test topology for T5 firewall validation. This is a single-host lab: the local host plays the INTERNAL/server_host role from segmentation_rules.json, so allow-flow targets resolve to loopback where the corresponding service is expected to be live, and deny-flow targets point at unreachable addresses in the zones that must never be reachable from here.

allow.justification: Administrative SSH access to internal hosts (sshd is live on this host)
Clinical workstation access to application server over HTTPS
Clinical application database access (mysqld is live on this host)
DMZ application access to internal database
DNS resolution through the management resolver
DNS resolution fallback through the management resolver

denied.name: guest-to-billing-db
denied.justification: DMZ guest-facing host must never reach the billing database directly

denied.name: internal-to-meddev-admin
denied.justification: Internal hosts cannot directly administer medical devices

denied.name: dmz-to-meddev
denied.justification: DMZ hosts must not initiate connections to medical devices

denied.name: internal-to-public-http
denied.justification: No unrestricted internal outbound access to the public Internet

denied.name: meddev-to-public-dns
denied.justification: Medical devices must not reach public DNS directly, only the management resolver

denied.name: internal-to-radiology-telnet
denied.justification: Legacy Telnet listener on the radiology lab PC must remain unreachable from other zones

denied.name: dmz-to-mgmt-ssh
denied.justification: DMZ hosts must not access management systems

denied.name: internal-to-dmz-unlisted
denied.justification: Internal hosts require explicitly authorized flows to DMZ; this port is not authorized
